messages.author: dcf243afdf88f4b2
messages.subject: renaming camtrap videos
parts:
Hi everyone! I know that working with videos in Camtrap R is a relatively new thing. I am trying to use this line of code to rename them but im having a hard time getting it to work. Any advice?

# raw image location
wd_images_raw <- system.file("pictures/raw_images", package = "camtrapR")  
# destination for renamed images to be copied to
wd_images_raw_renamed <- file.path(normalizePath(tempdir(), winslash = "/"), "raw_images_renamed")      

renaming.table2 <- imageRename(inDir               = wd_images_raw,
                               outDir              = wd_images_raw_renamed,      
                               hasCameraFolders    = FALSE,
                               copyImages          = FALSE
)
Thanks!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] renaming camtrap videos
parts:
Hello,
ImageRename currently only works with images, not videos. That may change in the future, but I can't say yet when I'll get to it.
Best regards,
J
